description: This source file defines utility functions for testing in the 'testing' package, such as creating and removing temporary directories, writing files, and handling errors within tests.

methods.name: TempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a unique name for testing purposes, terminates the test on failure.

methods.name: RemoveDir
methods.description: Removes a specified directory and terminates the test if removal fails.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file with specified data and permissions; returns an error if operation fails.

methods.name: FatalIfNil
methods.description: Checks if an error is nil; if not, fails the test with Fatal.
